state.project: Miu World: a 3D voxel learn-while-playing online game for all ages, like Minecraft; web now, mobile later. Built 100% by AI. Online is always on (owner removed the off switch). Friends work like normal online games (request + accept, bots too). Only the owner and one child play today; moderation work is parked until outsiders play.
state.plan: Co-op quests: a party of 2-4 (players or labelled companion bots) does one shared challenge (each holds a piece of the answer, hold a door/bridge together, team boss with shared HP); rewards per player computed by the server; no competitive scores; lessons stay playable solo.
facts: Parties (2-4, across maps), friends, blocks, reports and canned lines (no free text) already exist online.
The old plan said co-op stays closed to players outside the family until a moderation system is built; that predates the all-ages, always-online direction.
The companion-bots switch is now each player's own setting, on by default.

coop_audience.instructions: Who can be in a co-op challenge together before moderation exists?

criteria.any_party: Any party can start co-op (parties already need an accepted invite; there is no free text and players can block and report); build moderation before any public matchmaking with strangers.
criteria.friends_only: Only parties whose members are all friends with the leader (or bots) until moderation exists.
criteria.wait_for_moderation: Keep co-op closed to non-family players until moderation is built.

solo_with_bots.instructions: If a player starts a co-op challenge alone, what happens?

criteria.fill_with_bots_if_switch_on: Fill the free places with companion bots when the player's own bots switch is on (default on); otherwise ask her to invite friends.
criteria.never_fill: Never auto-fill; co-op needs other members invited.
